title: Delivery Challan Template
description: Free GST delivery challan format under Rule 55 with challan no., consignor and consignee GSTIN, HSN, quantity, purpose, e-way bill and transport details. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Rule 55 fields: challan no., date, consignor and consignee GSTIN
Item table with HSN, quantity, unit and value of goods
Purpose, transport, e-way bill and triplicate copy marking
useCases: Supply on approval or branch transfer
research: All references carry a serial challan no. and date, consignor and consignee name, address and GSTIN, items with HSN, quantity and value, the purpose of movement, vehicle/e-way bill details and signatures; Rule 55 asks for triplicate copies.

rows: **[MS plate, 10 mm thick, cut to size]**

blocks.text: Value in words: **[Rupees Ninety-Nine Thousand Nine Hundred Twenty Only]**

blocks.heading: Declaration
text: 1. These goods are sent for **job work under Section 143 of the CGST Act, 2017** and are not a sale. No GST is charged on this challan.
2. Processed goods and scrap are to be returned to the consignor within the period allowed by law, with a return challan quoting this number.
3. Issued in triplicate: **Original** for consignee, **Duplicate** for transporter, **Triplicate** for consignor.
4. Please check quantities on receipt and report any shortage or damage within [24 hours].
